problem_statement: Command delete callbacks can create or replace command entries while the same namespace is being dismantled. A snapshot-only traversal postpones callback-created entries in Tcl8.4/8.5 and changes trace-visible order.
question: Which C releases restart at the first command-table entry after each deletion, and which retain an entire table frontier for one pass?
